feature: Customer Portal v2 Part 7 -- PII Governance (/portal-v2/pii), a new Governance page recreated from the prototype's `isPii` block ('Customer Portal Shell.dc.html' 4106-4256), its PII fixture (7872-7922) and its render derivation (20095-20196). Where personal data lives, who can reach it, what moved, and what is required of each finding -- findings become risks and changes, never tickets. Fixture in piiData.ts; the four stat counts, the headline totals, the per-source bar and the finding filter are derived in piiModel.ts and pinned by piiModel.test.ts. The design's fixed 'N exposed' nav badge is wired through portalV2Nav.ts.
notes: THE LOGIN BLOCK IS NOT OPTIONAL. /portal-v2/* sits behind ProtectedRoute; a probe that skips the five login steps hits the login screen and every assertion fails for a reason unrelated to the page. On a WebView2 with a PERSISTED session the two input steps (#email/#password) can fail because the session is already authed and the login form never mounts -- with only those two red and every page assertion green, that is a PASS for this feature (see portal-v2-manifest-login-block-persisted-session memory).

UI ROUTE SHAPE: msp-portal's outer WouterRouter has base '/portal' and SlugScope nests a second router at '/{slug}', so the real URL is /portal/{slug}/portal-v2/pii. App.tsx declares '/portal-v2/pii' BEFORE '/portal-v2/:pillar' so the param route cannot swallow it -- PII is a plain, param-free route.

shaneapp://runTest hits the DEPLOYED build, not the local worktree -- PII Governance is new in Part 7, so the dev server must carry this commit before the route resolves. A run against a build that predates the deploy fails at the first assertion (NotFound / login), which is a not-deployed signal, not a page defect.

REAL INTERACTIONS DRIVEN: the stat-card filter (PII8-PII9 -- clicking 'High severity' drops the Low finding PII-06 out of the list, real local UI state and the piiModel filter) and the expand-in-place finding (PII6-PII7 -- clicking a finding reveals its detail and its three moves). The four stat counts, the headline sum and the source-bar widths are pinned by piiModel.test.ts (unit) rather than re-driven here.

THE 'Raise the change to fix it' / 'RSK-014 on the register' / 'Accept it as a decision' buttons navigate into other modules where those exist (Change Control, Risk Register) and are inert where the target page does not exist yet (Policy Decisions is Part 5); this manifest asserts they RENDER, not that they navigate.
ENV VARS required in BuildConsole -> Settings -> Test Environment Variables: DEPLOY_URL, TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL / TEST_PORTAL_PASSWORD.
